title: koeleria cristata var. pyramidata
intro: Koeleria cristata var. pyramidata, commonly known as Koeler's hair grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and promoting overall well-being. The health benefits of Koeler's hair grass include its ability to stimulate the immune system, improve respiratory function, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects.
